nodes.label: CI Verify Job
nodes.rationale: Runs npm ci then npm run verify on push to main/feature/fix/docs and PRs to main, using Node 22.

nodes.label: AtriumUI
nodes.rationale: Production-grade Lit/TypeScript/Vite custom component library for Home Assistant Lovelace, shipped as one tree-shaken ES module.

nodes.label: au-shell-grid
nodes.rationale: Single top-level Panel card for classic drag/resize grid and Apple Home → Rooms when floors is set.

nodes.label: Home Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Visual language defined in src/theme/tokens.ts; accent fallback #0a84ff; gap 12px.

nodes.label: Native Lovelace Card Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Every card validates YAML in setConfig, reacts only to tracked entity changes, exposes getConfigElement(), and tears down in disconnectedCallback.

nodes.label: Locked Architecture Constraints C1-C12
nodes.rationale: Single atrium-ui.js; Lit+TS+Vite; HA 2024.1+; native card contract; grid-fill; one shell; preserve healthy reuse; tokens SoT; validated executeAction; no idle always-on timers.

nodes.label: Lovelace Design System Principle
nodes.rationale: AtriumUI is one bundle with shared bases, domain cards, and a dashboard shell that owns layout persistence.

nodes.label: npm run verify
nodes.rationale: Verification surface: typecheck + lint + test + build; must pass on main.

nodes.label: Room Idle Timeout
nodes.rationale: Configurable room_idle_timeout seconds on au-shell-grid Home mode returns to Home after inactivity; 0/unset disables.

nodes.label: npm run dev:ha
nodes.rationale: Watch-build into HA www via HA_WWW / HA_BUILD=1.

nodes.label: Distribution and HACS Feature
nodes.rationale: Single dist/atrium-ui.js chunk via HACS Dashboard or manual www copy.

nodes.label: Calendar Card
nodes.rationale: Households want an Apple Calendar–inspired glance of HA calendar entities without leaving the dashboard.

nodes.label: calendar.get_events API
nodes.rationale: Read-only event fetch via HA 2023.12+ with WebSocket fallback; no create/edit in AtriumUI.

nodes.label: Climate Card
nodes.rationale: Climate entities expose HVAC modes, target temperature, and fan modes with varying capabilities; control without more-info.

nodes.label: HVAC Mode Selector
nodes.rationale: heat_cool labeled Auto; UI adapts to entity hvac_modes/fan_modes/temp attributes.

nodes.label: Cover Card
nodes.rationale: Covers need toggle plus optional open/close/stop and position for blinds and garage doors in-grid.

nodes.label: Fan Card
nodes.rationale: Fans need dedicated on/off plus optional speed, presets, oscillate, and direction; not via au-device-card.

nodes.label: Light Card
nodes.rationale: Lights vary in capability (on/off, brightness, CCT, RGB); UI should adapt and show only supported controls.

nodes.label: Light Capability-Driven UI
nodes.rationale: Hide unsupported sliders; RGB+CCT follows live color_mode; pending-control patterns shared Phase 3.

nodes.label: Room Card
nodes.rationale: Compact icon button row to toggle lights/switches for a room without opening each entity card.

nodes.label: Shell Room Controls
nodes.rationale: Home shell room-tile strip is shell-owned via room_controls; room card should share control icon helpers.

nodes.label: Switch Card
nodes.rationale: Switches should use explicit turn_on/turn_off from live state rather than generic toggle ambiguity.

nodes.label: Assessment Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Sole-dev priority is UI/UX consistency → security → bundle/perf → architecture/DX; breaking changes allowed.

nodes.label: Healthy Reuse Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Do not destroy AuActionCardBase, AuBaseEditor, CARDS registry, resolveDomainControl, home-edit-commit, or classic grid compat.

nodes.label: Home Visual Drift Finding
nodes.rationale: Sensors ignore Home variant; README/edit chrome still use Material #03a9f4 while tokens use Home #0a84ff.

nodes.label: Unvalidated executeAction Finding
nodes.rationale: Production trust gap: executeAction does not validate call-service / url / navigate before side effects.

nodes.label: Always-On Device Timer Finding
nodes.rationale: Device card setInterval(1000) runs always; should arm only when needed.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Shipped Spine
nodes.rationale: Complete for core library on main: installable module, classic+Home shell, domain cards, editors, Vitest.

nodes.label: PRD Decision Log D1-D14
nodes.rationale: Key product decisions: single chunk, one shell, Home tokens SoT, au-*-card tags, HA-native actions, grid-fill, priority order, reuse, sensor Home variant, action safety, armed timers.

nodes.label: D2 One Shell Card
nodes.rationale: One card au-shell-grid for classic grid and Home → Rooms via floors; nested au-home-dashboard removed.

nodes.label: D7 Priority Order
nodes.rationale: UI/UX consistency → security → bundle/perf → architecture/DX.

nodes.label: D10 Action Safety
nodes.rationale: executeAction MUST validate services/urls/navigate.

nodes.label: PRD Precedence Rule
nodes.rationale: On conflicts, PRD.md and prd/ win over this wishlist capture; architecture constraints always apply.

nodes.label: Card Contract Feature
nodes.rationale: Native Lovelace lifecycle, grid-fill, action defaults, and validated executeAction.

nodes.label: Shell Grid Feature
nodes.rationale: One layout host for classic coordinate grid and Home → Rooms without a second top-level card type.

nodes.label: Action Card
nodes.rationale: Dashboards need a generic reactive tile for toggleable entities without a dedicated domain card.

nodes.label: Device Card
nodes.rationale: Some domains lack a dedicated card but still need an adaptive tile; must not replace fan/cover/switch/vacuum cards.

nodes.label: Device Card Confirm Actions
nodes.rationale: Confirm before high-stakes actions when enabled.

nodes.label: Device Card Timer Ticker Discipline
nodes.rationale: Timers/tickers arm only when needed (D11); MUST NOT use always-on 1s setInterval when idle.

nodes.label: Sensor Card
nodes.rationale: Environmental sensors need a glanceable gauge with severity, including Home mode tiles (D9 Phase 1).

nodes.label: Sensor Severity Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Severity direction above/below drives warn/critical styling.

nodes.label: Sensor Home Variant Path
nodes.rationale: Home variant MUST use Home tile styles/tokens (not Material-only chrome); Phase 1 fix per D9.

nodes.label: Vacuum Card
nodes.rationale: Vacuums need start/pause/stop/return plus deep device settings across many related entities without hunting.

nodes.label: Vacuum Settings Overlay
nodes.rationale: Auto-discover same-device entities; Essentials + Advanced; draft until Apply; hold opens settings replacing more-info.

nodes.label: Edit Mode
nodes.rationale: Users need to rearrange shell layouts and configure cards without hand-editing YAML for every change.

nodes.label: Edit Mode Draft/Commit Discipline
nodes.rationale: Prefer single draft → commit path; dual drafts / eager commit is a bug to fix (Phase 4).

nodes.label: Home Tiles
nodes.rationale: Home mode must read as one visual language (squircle tiles, domain-colored on fills, large type), not a mix of Material and Home.

nodes.label: variant: home
nodes.rationale: Injected by shell for Home entities; tokens win over Material hex drift (no #03a9f4).

nodes.label: Localize
nodes.rationale: UI chrome must follow the user’s HA language, including Hebrew RTL.

nodes.label: Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: src/theme/tokens.ts (auTokens) is the visual source of truth for Home look; README and edit chrome must match.

nodes.label: Session Follow-ups
nodes.rationale: Living backlog of graphify/architecture questions; Phase 3-4 product backlog tracked here after Phase 1-2 reconcile.
